features.name: Upgrade better-auth 1.6 -> 1.7.7
features.description: Bump better-auth, @better-auth/passkey and @better-auth/api-key to ^1.7.7 together in packages/auth, packages/ui and apps/web. Keep @better-auth-ui/* at 1.6.x (peer range allows better-auth >=1.6.19). Never target 1.7.0-1.7.2 (account.issuer migration); 1.7.3+ keeps the account schema unchanged. Steps: (1) read-only DB pre-check for duplicate (provider_id, account_id) rows and no issuer column; (2) bump; (3) fix type errors (usePlural now gives singular many-to-one relation keys); (4) regenerate the schema with the new `auth` CLI into a scratch file and diff with packages/database/src/schema/auth.sql.ts, expecting no table change (if a migration is needed, stop and ask); (5) switch auth:generate from the stale @better-auth/cli (1.4.21) to the `auth` package; (6) smoke test that createAuth() builds; (7) manual sign-in check with an existing user against a copy of the DB. No schema migration expected. Rollback is a revert if no schema change.
features.scope: packages/auth, apps/web/package.json, packages/ui/package.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, packages/database/src/schema/auth.sql.ts only if the diff requires it
features.evidence: 2026-10-10 devcontainer: ./init.sh --full passed (33 tests incl. createAuth smoke test). Local DB pre-check ok (no duplicate (provider_id, account_id), no issuer column, only credential accounts). `auth@1.7.7 generate` vs auth.sql.ts: no table/column changes (no DB migration); only relation keys users -> user. Hash check: 1.7 verifies 1.6 scrypt hashes and vice versa. Fixes: linked-account.tsx now passes account.id to accountInfo/unlinkAccount (1.7 identifies accounts by row id), typed resolvedUser in user-avatar/user-view, zod aligned to ^4.5.4 (dedupes zod), @better-auth/api-key and oauth-provider made direct deps at ^1.7.7, auth:generate now uses auth@1.7.7. User confirmed local sign-in with an existing user works. Settings/security pages and OAuth providers are not used (not in production either), so those paths are untested by design. Optional low-risk check before production deploy: the duplicate-account SQL on Neon (only credential accounts are expected).

features.name: Sync shadcn components from the registry
features.description: Refresh the existing shadcn components in packages/ui so they match the current base-nova registry before the better-auth-ui upgrade. Do NOT run `shadcn add --all`: a dry run showed it creates ~32 new components (drawer, table, toast, questionnaire, ...), adds 10 dependencies and touches use-mobile.ts. Instead run from packages/ui, inside the devcontainer, with the exact list of existing components: `pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add avatar badge breadcrumb button calendar card chart checkbox collapsible combobox dialog dropdown-menu field input-group input item label popover select separator sheet sidebar skeleton slider sonner spinner switch tabs textarea tooltip --overwrite --yes` (dry run: 31 files overwritten, 0 created, 7 dependency entries: cn, sonner, next-themes, react-day-picker@latest, date-fns, recharts@3.8.0, @base-ui/react). Expected effects to review: every component now imports `cn` from the shadcn `cn` package (drop-in for clsx + tailwind-merge) instead of @repo/ui/lib/utils; files come unformatted in registry style (no semicolons), which is fine because Biome ignores them; packages/ui/package.json and the lockfile may change (make sure react-day-picker stays on the ^10 major and the lockfile still installs with the pinned pnpm 10.28.1, check `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`); globals.css may be touched (review). Note the CLI uses its own pnpm (v12) via dlx: verify the lockfile format is still version 9.0 and revert unrelated changes. Verify: git diff review, `./init.sh --full`, and a visual check of the app (sidebar, dialogs, calendar, charts, dropdown menus). Roll back by reverting the commit; do not touch packages/ui/src/components/auth (that is feat-009).
features.scope: packages/ui (src/components/*.tsx excluding auth/, src/hooks/use-mobile.ts, package.json, possibly src/styles/globals.css), pnpm-lock.yaml
features.evidence: 2026-10-10 devcontainer: ran shadcn add with the 30 existing component names --overwrite --yes from packages/ui (31 files overwritten incl. use-mobile.ts, none created). ./init.sh --full passed (33 tests). packages/ui/package.json: +cn ^0.4.0, react-day-picker ^10.0.1 -> ^10.0.2; lockfile still v9.0; globals.css untouched. Format-normalized diff review: mostly import/export reordering; real changes: dead classes cn-rtl-flip/cn-font-heading removed (not defined in our CSS), dialog/sheet close button restructured, sidebar hook deps fixed, switch/checkbox focus-ring classes in field labels, field.tsx uses == and index key (registry code, kept as is). User visually checked the app after the sync: works well.
